raw_segments.text: Now the various species of whales need some sort of popular comprehensive classification,
if only an easy outline one for the present, hereafter to be filled in all its departments
As no better man advances to take this matter in hand, I hear upon offer my own poor endeavors.
I promise nothing complete, because any human thing supposed to be complete must for that
I shall not pretend to a minute anatomical description of the various species, or, in
this place at least, to much of any description.
My object here is simply to project the draft of a systematization of satology.
I am the architect, not the builder.
